ticket.subject: Cancel my subscription
ticket.message: Please cancel my monthly subscription (SUB-4410) before the next billing date.

retrieved_chunks.text:
# Subscription Policy

## Billing and Renewal
- Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless the customer cancels before the renewal date.
- Cancellation requests are effective at the end of the current billing period unless otherwise stated by the account settings.
- Customers may cancel their subscription at any time, but no refund is guaranteed for the current billing period.

## Plan Changes
- Customers may switch plans at any time from the billing settings page.
- Plan changes take effect at the next billing cycle.

## Escalation Guidance
Escalate when:
- the customer disputes a renewal charge,
- the account shows a failed payment but the customer disputes the charge,
- or the customer requests a special exception outside standard billing policy.

# Troubleshooting FAQ

## Common Technical Issues
- If the app is not loading, ask the user to refresh the browser and check the internet connection.
- If the customer cannot log in, verify the username and password and use the password reset function.
- If the customer reports a billing mismatch, confirm the subscription plan and billing date before answering.
